title: Async types: Promise, AsyncIterable, and AbortSignal — concept map
intro: Promise<T> return types, Awaited unwrapping, AsyncIterable typing, AbortSignal cancellation types, async error typing, and comparison to C# Task and IAsyncEnumerable.

overviewDiagram.title: Async type relationships
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  AF[async function] --> P[Promise<T> return]
  P --> AW[Awaited unwrap]
  AI[AsyncIterable] --> FAF[for await of]
  AC[AbortController] --> AS[AbortSignal on fetch]

conceptCards.title: Promise<T> return types
conceptCards.summary: async fn always returns Promise even if you return T. Annotate Promise<User> or let inference work.

conceptCards.title: Awaited<T>
conceptCards.summary: Recursive infer unwraps nested Promise. Use in generic mapAsync helpers.

conceptCards.title: AsyncIterable types
conceptCards.summary: AsyncGenerator, for-await-of typing. Streaming without loading all.

conceptCards.title: AbortSignal typing
conceptCards.summary: signal?: AbortSignal on fetch options. Typed cancellation propagation.

conceptCards.title: Async error typing
conceptCards.summary: Promise rejection untyped by default. Result types or unknown catch.

conceptCards.title: vs C# Task
conceptCards.summary: Promise<T> erases. Task<T> real CLR type. IAsyncEnumerable parallels AsyncIterable.
